text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the start of summer camp, where Umamusume train to improve their skills.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I heard Japanese summer camps have pillow fights at night! Is that true?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Back-breakin' training during the day, then pillow fights when the sun goes down. Japanese camps sure are wild…
choice_data_list: (I don't think it's a hard rule…)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But that won't be a problem for me! See, I'm gonna be the first ever sprinter to become Umamusume of the Year!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'll kill it in my training and my pillow fights!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So begins a thrilling summer camp with Taiki Shuttle!
